version.description: Strict Semantic Versioning of the release (e.g., 1.0.0).

description.description: A concise, one-sentence summary of what the entity does.

maintainers.description: List of maintainers who own this entity.

repository.description: The URL to the Git repository where the source files live.

home.description: The URL of this entity's home page, wiki, or documentation.

keywords.description: A list of descriptive keywords for UI discoverability.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this entity is deprecated and should no longer be used.

aggregate.description: Pointer to the Aggregate (Developer Intent) this release deploys.

manifest.description: Pointer to the Manifest dependency lockfile resolving the abstract interfaces.

extends.description: Enables base-layer inheritance for frictionless local Dev Loops vs Prod deployments.

parameters.description: Environment-specific variable fulfillment contract with two authoring modes via content-shape dispatch. Mode 1 (inline): a YAML map carrying structured nested parameter values directly. Mode 2 (file import): a YAML map of exactly one key, `$import: ./relative/path.yaml`, pointing at a single local file that supplies the parameter values. Single-source-only at this site — the pre-migration array form (`parametersFrom: [a, b, c]`) is removed; the multi-file layering use case migrates to Release `extends:` chains (the parent Release supplies base parameters; the child extends + overrides).

boundaries.description: The root logical boxes into which the Aggregate's components are routed.

boundary_component.description: A component instance routed into a boundary, with optional physical sizing and feature attachments.

description.description: Optional documentation describing this component's deployment context in this boundary.

subDirectory.description: Component-level sub-path override appended to the parent boundary's directory. If omitted on both boundary and component, defaults to '{{ .provider }}'. Set to '.' or '' to disable sub-directory generation.

annotations.description: Component-specific Operator annotations that override boundary-level annotations for this component. Deep-merged over boundary annotations (component wins on key collision). Used for per-component provider well-known annotation overrides (e.g., aggrega.ai/chart-name). The provider is responsible for validating consistency when grouping components (e.g., helm-chart provider rejects components with different aggrega.ai/namespace values in the same chart). Explicit null on a key inherited from the parent boundary removes the inherited binding from this component (annotation-driven Feature opt-out); sibling components retain the inherited binding.

infra.description: Physical sizing strictly local to this component (e.g., replicas, disk IOPS).

features.description: Features attached to this component via the Release. For features also declared in the Aggregate, only infra is provided (values come from the Aggregate). For Release-only features (Operator-injected), type is required. The Release MUST NOT provide values for features — this is the Developer's domain.

type.description: The URI of the Feature. Required for Release-only features (Operator-injected). Must match the Aggregate's type if both declare it.

description.description: Optional documentation explaining why the Operator attached this feature at this boundary level.

infra.description: Operational sizing for this specific feature (e.g., target_var, sidecar_cpu, namespace_annotation).

secrets.description: Credential Features (labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret) attached via the Release. Only infra is allowed (no values — credential values come from the Aggregate).

type.description: The URI of the credential Feature. Required for Release-only secrets (Operator-injected). Must match the Aggregate's type if both declare it.

description.description: Optional documentation explaining why the Operator attached this credential at this boundary level.

infra.description: Operational sizing for this credential feature (e.g., specific AWS Vault ARN, region).

aggregate_routing.description: Routes a nested Aggregate sub-module's internal components into this boundary. Mirrors the boundary's component/aggregate structure for recursive composition.

components.description: Component instances within the nested aggregate to route into this boundary.

aggregates.description: Further nested aggregates within this sub-aggregate (for deeply nested module composition).

description.description: Optional documentation describing this boundary's purpose and physical target (e.g., 'Primary production EKS cluster in us-east-1, PCI-DSS compliant').

directory.description: Physical output path for GitOps artifact generation. Supports Go template variables ({{ .provider }}, {{ .boundary_name }}, {{ .parameters.X }}). Combined with subDirectory via filepath.Join to produce the final artifact path.

subDirectory.description: Boundary-level sub-path appended to directory. If omitted on both boundary and component, defaults to '{{ .provider }}' for CI/CD auto-partitioning. Set to '.' or '' to disable.

syncWave.description: Optional per-boundary deployment wave (signed integer, default 0). Every component in this boundary inherits the boundary's wave value into its IR node. Negative values are permitted (run before everything else); larger values run after lower values. Maps to provider-native sequencing artifacts at render time (argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave annotation for K8s/Helm; depends_on chains for Terraform; DependsOn for CloudFormation; no-op for Compose). Nested boundaries do not implicitly inherit — each declares its own wave.

annotations.description: Boundary-wide Operator annotations cascading down to the .context.annotations.release bucket. Values are strings or null; explicit null on a key inherited from a parent boundary removes the inherited binding from this boundary's effective annotation set (annotation-driven Feature opt-out), propagating to every component routed into this boundary unless a deeper override re-introduces the binding.

features.description: Boundary-wide features applied to all nested components (e.g., default security mesh).

secrets.description: Boundary-wide secrets accessible by all nested components.

boundaries.description: Nested logical boundaries (e.g., namespaces within a cluster).

components.description: Which components from the Aggregate are placed in this boundary.

aggregates.description: Routes nested Aggregate sub-module components into this boundary. Keys are aggregate instance names matching the Aggregate's spec.aggregates map. All aggregate instances must be placed in exactly one boundary if boundaries are defined.
